Selection barriers

Why a generic 'full-service cleaning' listing can mislead a buyer

Homes, retail units, offices and industrial sites differ in access, equipment, hazards, service specification and quality expectations.

01

Operations and exclusions are unclear

Routine home cleaning, renovation debris, high windows and specialist building maintenance are different tasks. Providers must distinguish included work from paid extras and access restrictions.

02

References to technical standards imply certification

GOST R 51870-2014 describes general cleaning services, whereas GOST R 57582-2017 addresses quality assessment. Quoting standards is not a certificate held by the provider.

03

Price and safety promises ignore the job

Floor area, stains, materials, staffing and geography affect cost. No cleaning chemical should be assumed harmless for every surface or household.

Verifiable facts

Evidence that supports a professional cleaning recommendation

GOST R 51870-2014 gives general specifications for professional cleaning, GOST R 57582-2017 addresses service quality assessments, and GOST R 72719-2026 has applied since 1 October 2026 to lean cleaning organisation. They have different functions and none alone certifies a particular business.

  • Work specification, property type, authorised equipment and surface/material limits
  • Quality inspections, acceptance process, permissioned case material and substantiated team capabilities
  • Hours, coverage, pricing assumptions, liability terms and genuine contact methods

This is an information-quality approach, not evidence that a particular cleaner achieved a certain BMR or service level.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Is deep cleaning the same as post-construction cleaning?+

No. The starting soil and tasks differ. The exact scope and exclusions must be established before pricing.

Which professional cleaning standards are current?+

GOST R 51870-2014 covers general service specifications and GOST R 57582-2017 deals with quality assessment. GOST R 72719-2026 has been effective since October 2026 for lean organisation.

Does listing GOST mean the company is certified?+

No. A standard reference alone does not substantiate provider qualifications, actual operations or quality.

Can cleaning chemicals be promoted as universally safe?+

No. Compatibility and limitations depend on the product, surface and application conditions, and need manufacturer documentation.

What does cleaning company GEO cost?+

GAEO's published pricing applies. Scope depends on service types, territories, schedules and the baseline prompt set.
